- symptom: the visible materials yield two final settlement amounts, 6863.20 and 6938.20, depending on whether the linked special order program's vendor delay threshold is at least 9 days; the blind answer picked 6863.20 without visible support.
- root cause: the factor document carries the threshold only by name; the figure is a per-program term of Ridgeline Special Order Services (source: `linked_delay_threshold: "CPARAM('special', 'vendor_delay_threshold_days', linked_install_contract_id=HID)"`; blueprint/products/special.yaml, Semi-Custom Cabinetry `vendor_delay_threshold_days: 21`). - evidence: `special_order_materials_lateness_allowance_a266dae1.json` — "the special order program's vendor delay threshold marks the lateness that program's own delay remedies take over; when the materials lateness is more than the long-lateness days of 14 and no more than that threshold ... when it is above 0 and no more than both the long-lateness days and that threshold, the short lateness allowance of 75.00 applies"; "Records that decide the allowance: ... the vendor delay threshold of its special order program". Record: promised_ready_date 2026-07-22, ready_date 2026-07-31.
- affected document/location: special_order_materials_lateness_allowance_a266dae1.json, Clause and "Records that decide the allowance". The same omission is recorded as a factor-ladder figure omission in policy_kb/0.md.
